name: com.sungchan.mcptools
description: A 4-stage AI asset generation pipeline (AssetListup -> PromptBuilder -> ComfyUIGenerator -> AssetApplier) driven by game design documents, provided as Unity Editor Tools and MCP tools. Generates images/sounds locally via ComfyUI, presents 4 candidates for user selection, and automatically applies the chosen assets to prefabs and uGUI. The uGUI, 2D Sprite, and unity-mcp packages are optional dependencies. (기획서 기반 AI 에셋 생성 4단계 파이프라인을 Unity Editor Tool + MCP 도구로 제공합니다. ComfyUI 로컬 생성, 후보 4개 선택, 프리팹/UI 자동 적용을 지원하며 uGUI·2D Sprite·unity-mcp 패키지는 선택 사항입니다.)
